output.notes: Described the headline pretrained Longformer, an encoder-only model whose MLM pretraining continues from the RoBERTa checkpoint. Base and large sizes are given. Sizes, norm type and placement, eps, GELU, biases and tied head are marked inherited from RoBERTa via the continue-pretraining sentence; the paper itself does not restate them. RoBERTa's single-type token_type embedding is omitted from the embed subgraph. Window 512 is the total bidirectional window (256 per side); no dilation in this setting, since dilation hurt with RoBERTa weights. Global attention is task-specific and absent in MLM pretraining, so it is listed outside the IR. Not described here: the char-LM variant (Transformer-XL based; 12 or 30 layers, 512 hidden, 8 heads, pre-LN, relative sinusoidal positions, causal dilated windows) and LED (an encoder-decoder initialised from BART).

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Task-specific symmetric global attention on pre-selected tokens (e.g. [CLS], question tokens). It uses a separate set of projections Q_g, K_g, V_g, initialised as copies of Q_s, K_s, V_s, and is combined with the sliding-window attention during finetuning.
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: We use two sets of projections, $Q_s$, $K_s$, $V_s$ to compute attention scores of sliding window attention, and  $Q_g$, $K_g$, $V_g$ to  compute attention scores for the global attention.
mechanisms_outside_ir.where: Sec. 3.1 Linear Projections for Global Attention

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Global attention is symmetric: a global token attends to all tokens, and all tokens attend to it.
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote:
Importantly, we make this attention operation symmetric: that is, a token
with a global attention attends to all tokens across the sequence, and all tokens in the sequence attend to it.

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: The 4096-position embedding table is initialised by repeatedly copying RoBERTa's 512 learned position embeddings.
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote:
we initialize them by copying the 512 position
embeddings from RoBERTa multiple times
